svg.text: Programs and competitions by strand and year line. Time runs down the page.

Shaded bands are school terms; the gaps are holidays. A year line bends out to make room for a competition’s name and bends back after it. Programs that overlap on one year line split it into parallel tracks.
Round chains run on a branch off their program and end at a ringed final. A program too short for its name shows the name in a tag beside it.
